title: ENGR 230: Digital Logic Design
summary: Digital circuits designed, simulated, and implemented with Boolean algebra, HDL, and FPGAs.

cover.alt: Open purple notebook with a pen beside color-swatch cards

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Designed, simulated, and implemented digital circuits using Boolean algebra and Hardware Description Languages (HDL). Optimized combinational and sequential logic systems, addressed logic hazards, and developed projects on FPGAs.
Gained hands-on experience in the full development cycle: specification, design, testing, and documentation of digital hardware systems.
